— 🇮🇷 Continuation of the message by Iran’s Supreme Leader:
‘And among other important issues and topics is the application of technologies and innovations proposed by our young elite. Sometimes, timely use of this advantage and abandoning the usual routine and customary habits in a matter makes effective leaps in the path of progress and excellence of the country. This is conceivable in various branches of power production, including agriculture and industry, culture and education, communication and social affairs.
Among the other fundamental issues of the country that must always be at the center of attention is observing unity and caring for social cohesion. Every action in each of the cultural, social, political, security, and macro-economic areas must be taken with consideration of the attachment related to social cohesion. Some measures that may appear to have supporters among some segments of the country, if they lack this appendix or if what is formulated as an appendix in that case is neglected as an action, can cause harm to those segments and others. 
Undoubtedly, any disappointing speech and weakening of national and public cohesion and any kind of imaginary contradictions such as war or negotiation, consensus or extremism, compromise or war-mongering that has caused direct or indirect damage to our beloved people in the past can have the same effect from now on. 
Therefore, I firmly declare that committing anything that is detrimental to social cohesion is prohibited. 
And among other important issues, is the trans-strategic attention to the issue of culture, education and upbringing. The term trans-strategic means that the formulation of other strategies must be done with this issue in mind. In this regard, it is of particular importance to pay attention to the groups that are the source of spreading positive and constructive culture, such as teachers in education, universities, and seminaries, as well as nurses and doctors who have dedicated themselves to performing their duties in non-private institutions; just as it is to pay attention to the role of housewives who teach the most delicate elements of the beautiful and desirable culture of the future to each and every child of this land and region in the privacy of their homes. 
It is hoped that the implementation of these and other useful materials that can be found, thank God, in the list of government programs will lead our beloved country towards an ever stronger Iran and make those active in this path worthy of the special attention of Imam Mahdi, may God hasten his return.’

events.text:
—❗️🇮🇷 Iran’s Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Sayyed Mojtaba Khamenei, gives his thoughts on the economy:
‘The dear people of Iran, who have revealed their true caliber in the past six months in various manifestations of jihad with the enemy, their presence in the streets, their solidarity, empathy and companionship, deserve to feel the service of the responsible branches and institutions in the Islamic Republic on the path to achieving the desired level of this sacred system and the high dignity of the nation. 
Of course, what I will state now is already at the center of attention of the government, and mentioning it here is merely a reminder:
Among the necessities is the need to pay serious attention to the chain of economic-livelihood challenges such as inflation, unemployment, price management and the market for goods and services, and special attention to some other elements of the economy such as GDP growth, increasing investment and directing it towards useful and essential areas, production boom, gradual abandonment of the dollar, and ultimately, placing the economy at the center of a set of resistance economy policies. 
The main key in this regard to solving all these issues is to rely more and more on domestic production. 
Of course, establishing a sufficient level of public and specialized goods is a definite necessity, considering which, in cases where domestic production is not sufficient, imports should be used correctly and wisely. 
Naturally, encouraging production and at the same time managing imports and prices can lead to a situation where the dark spots that are showing themselves on the country's economic page gradually become smaller and smaller until they disappear completely. In this scene, although the enemy's behavior (sanctions etc.) during and after the war is not without an effect, the more intelligent management of the components of this field and seeking help in some cases from individuals and in others from specialists and technologists and realizing new capacities will lead the country towards expansion and prosperity. 
The sworn enemy of this nation [United States] tries to suggest that the path to prosperity and progress passes only through obedience to him and his ridiculous demands, while observing what they have brought upon this country and its resources in past periods, even years before the Islamic Revolution, shows the opposite.‘

—❗️🇺🇸/🇪🇺/🇷🇺 BREAKING: U.S. Patriot interceptor stockpiles in Europe are at ‘beyond critical’ levels due to the Iran war, according to AP
A senior U.S. official said that in the event of a Russian ballistic missile attack on a military headquarters or power plant for example, NATO would be in a similar position to Ukraine and be forced ‘to take punch after punch in the mouth’.
In Europe, the American military ‘definitely’ does not have enough Patriots to stop any sustained ballistic missile attack and would have ‘very limited’ capability to defend against a single ballistic missile strike or a stray Russian missile that goes off course, the U.S. official said to the Associated Press.

events.title: Telegram
events.text:
The U.S. has transferred large quantities of missiles and air-defense systems to the Middle East for the Iran war, leaving some stockpiles in Europe and Asia at critically low levels, according to U.S. officials.
Patriot, ATACMS and other precision weapons have been heavily depleted, while THAAD interceptors and counterdrone systems have also been shifted to the region. Replenishing inventories could take years.
The shortages are forcing U.S. commanders to adjust contingency plans and have raised concerns about Washington’s ability to respond simultaneously to a potential Chinese attack on Taiwan or a Russian threat to NATO.
Source: WSJ

events.text:
⚡️🇺🇸🇮🇷 — US officials reported a watershed moment as American forces established effective control over most of the Strait of Hormuz to secure a better deal with Tehran and provide global economic relief.
"That sucker is open. The Iranian response is very mild. They don't want us to go back at them. That's the whole ball game. The rest doesn't matter," President Trump told Axios.
Israeli and US officials attribute the initial closure within the first 72 hours of the war and naval mine deployment in the Traffic Separation Scheme to former IRGC Navy commander General Alireza Tangsiri, killed three weeks later in an Israeli airstrike in Bandar Abbas — Axios.
➡️ US military forces swept over 200 mine-like objects from international lanes, confirming only 11 as actual mines, contributing to a reduced 2% vessel strike rate over the last month. Nightly traffic through the southern channel grew to 20-30 tankers carrying an average of 9-10 million barrels, roughly half of pre-war volume. The US-protected operation includes the UAE, Bahrain, and Kuwait, with Saudi Arabian participation expected and US planners hoping Qatar will imminently transit liquefied natural gas tankers.
➡️ US negotiators aim to widen the main channel by mid-September to accommodate 50 nightly transits and restore 60-70% of pre-war exports despite external tanker tracker skepticism. Iranian officials requested diplomatic interventions, prompting visits to Tehran by the Pakistani army commander on Sunday, the Omani foreign minister, and the Qatari prime minister on Thursday to discuss maritime mediation. President Trump claims he is not interested in negotiating while envoy Steve Witkoff maintains contact with Qatari mediators.
➡️ White House officials dismiss the June 17 Memorandum of Understanding as no longer relevant and treat Oman-Iran talks as background noise. US operators rely on the ongoing blockade and economic pressure campaign to force Tehran to soften its position, while Iran publicly demands the US implement the original memorandum and offer terms to reopen the strait.
⭐️ Follow

🔍 Hegseth weighing second Quantico summons for top military leaders — timing raises eyebrows
Secretary of War Crimes Pete Hegseth is considering inviting hundreds of senior military personnel back to Marine Corps Base Quantico for a second address this year, according to US officials, cited by a WSJ report — the same venue where he delivered his "no more beardos" speech last fall.
Here's why the timing matters.
The Calendar
🔴 Last September: Hegseth summoned every general and admiral on short notice, no stated reason. Trump opened the event. The message: return to "warfighting."
🔴 February: The United States was at war with Iran.
🔴 Now: Hegseth is eyeing Quantico again — this time with a war underway, a purge in progress, and a political calendar closing in.
The Political Window
🔶 Marco Rubio has reportedly told foreign counterparts that new strikes are off until after the November midterms. Another campaign could follow.
🔶 Whatever directives get issued at Quantico, every officer in that room will be reading them against that window.
The Purge Factor
Hegseth's massive overhaul of the Pentagon has shaken up the ranks. Senior officers are being pushed out. The military leadership is nervous, and political loyalty is being tested.
Sending them all back to Quantico sends a message: "I'm in charge. You'll either fall in line or fall out."
👉 The military is being reshaped in real time. Whether or not the Quantico address happens, it is already a signal.
The war with Iran has exposed fault lines. The purge has deepened them. Now, Hegseth is desperate to keep the generals on board.
